summary: Comprehensive backend (pytest, 15/15 passing) and frontend (Playwright) testing of Solana meme coin screener. All 6 listing/filter endpoints, token detail, AI analyze (Anthropic Claude live integration with 15-min cache), and Telegram endpoints (unconfigured handling) verified. Frontend dashboard loads, displays 55 tokens with badges, filters work, Telegram dialog & error handling work, AnalyzeSheet renders all 3 gauges + verdict + summary + key points + red flags + twitter links.

minor.issue: When telegram unconfigured, endpoint returns 200 with empty sent[] only if any token would have triggered an alert (the first _send_telegram raises HTTPException(400) caught and break). If NO tokens meet threshold, also returns 200. Behavior is graceful but not explicit — consider checking telegram config up-front and returning 400 for clarity.
Fallback path: when DexScreener returns no pairs for an invalid address (empty body), endpoint correctly returns 404. Tested OK.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 581 lines — still manageable but approaching split threshold; consider extracting DexScreener client, AI client, and Telegram into modules.
In-memory _cache dict is per-worker only; if scaled to multiple uvicorn workers, cache hit rate would drop. OK for current single-worker deployment.

telegram_scan_and_alert: breaking on first telegram failure is correct behavior, but the endpoint returns 200 even when telegram is misconfigured — users may be confused. Consider validating config up-front.
analyze_token caches in MongoDB but never purges expired entries — over time db.analyses grows unbounded. Add TTL index on created_at.
test_credentials: N/A — no auth in this app
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests at /app/backend/tests/test_screener.py (15 tests, all passing). AnalyzeSheet uses Radix Sheet via portal; data-testid 'dash-analyze-sheet' appears after click within ~500ms. AI gauges (dash-hype-gauge, dash-community-gauge, dash-buy-signal-gauge) appear after Anthropic call completes (~3-10s first time, instant on cache). Telegram is intentionally unconfigured per user — /api/telegram/test returns 400 'not configured' as expected.
rca_of_issue: No bugs found. Initial Playwright timeout was a transient race condition during the first end-to-end script; focused retest succeeded on first attempt.
